items.title: Using Trains to Bridge Districts - Fire Barons #5
items.description: Patreon: https://patreon.com/cw/Zeddic Note: Modded Playthrough (see below for mods) Map: Oasis Difficulty: Hard Timberborn is a post apocalyptic game where beavers have inherited the earth and you are responsible for leading them to build a thriving colony. In this episode I continue to go deeper with the Choo Choo mod! After running into some trickiness running logistic networks within the same district, I now suspect that the trains will work best in a multi-district setup. With their speed and massive storage capacity, they may be the key to bypassing the bottlenecks I normally see when using district crossings to connect different districts. In this video: - I setup a new district in the Suburbs, along with its own amenities - Use trains to ferry goods to/from the new district - Construct a new dam to help secure our water supply - Begin construction of a new tunnel to build a new ring route for our track - Start laying down track for a future "highlands" district Emberpelts: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3346318229 Choo Choo: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3765935439 Bobingabout Commute Balancer: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3663421750 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Mods: - Emberpelt - Choo Choo - TImprove Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers #emberpelts

items.description: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764460/Sandustry/ Sandustry is a game about converting sand into gold by creating a factory in a sand physics environment! In this video I'm on the hunt for a solution: I want to find a way to a way to process these things into something useful so I can open up the factory again. In order to that, I'm going to need to go on an adventure and start exploring more of the map. We really need to find lava and more ways to reliably generate heat to process these goods. items.title: A Road Runs Through It - Fire Barons #2
items.description: MODDED EMBERPELT PLAYTHROUGH (see below for mods) Difficulty: Hard Map: Oasis The droughts are getting longer and its getting harder to keep our basin hydrated. If we are to have any hope on this map, we need to get out of this basin and start getting some other sources of water so we don't need to rely on just a single water seep. Luckily I spy a drill just on the nearby cliff. And what better way to get there but with some of the new Emberpelt mechanics? Can we get that new water source online in time before the colony dies? items.title: Shifting Sand for Gold - Sandustry
items.description: Today we're trying out a new game on the channel: Sandustry! This game is an interesting mix of pixel physics and automation. We're sent to a planet with the goal of creating an automated factory to mine for gold. To pull this off we need to create elaborate 2d factories using pixel physics to mine, transform, and refine sand into various products. If you've ever played the classic "falling sand" sand-box games in your browser - you'll instantly recognize how the world works. In this video I'll be learning how the game works and working my way through the first 3 tech trees. Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764460/Sandustry/ Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #sandustry #automation #strategy #letsplay

items.title: Playing with Fire - Fire Barons #1
items.description: It's a new season and it is time for a modded playthough! This video kicks off a new playthrough with the Emberpelts, a modded faction that is fascinated with fire and not getting wet. And to make things more interesting, I'm throwing in the Choo Choo mod, which adds functioning trains to the game so I can ultimately create a giant logistics network crossing the map. I'm kicking things off on the Oasis map on hard difficulty, one of the maps that is centered around water seeps as your starting water. This episode covers: - Getting the colony running with an initial tree farm, water, and food - Tinkering with Emberpelt homes that let beavers use them as roads - Building a bad water diversion system around the water seep - Progressing up to planks and gears Difficulty: Hard Map: Oasis Emberpelts: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3346318229 Choo Choo: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3765935439 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Mods: - Emberpelt - Choo Choo - TImprove Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers #emberpelts

items.title: Like a dam, but for air! - Thornbreakers #15
items.description: With the Thornbreaker's colony secure and containing a strong industry, it's time to start building something crazy. I want to expand out of the basin and really start terraforming more of the map. Of course, none of this newly terraformed land should be left out in the open... which is where the WALL comes in! In this video: - Tear out majority of the thorns on the map - Adding water dumping ponds across the center, reclaiming a lot of land - Construct a massive circular wall to protect everything - Start construction of a new vault expansion - Add a hidden web of tube way networks across the map for easy access to any point of the wall The tool I used to draw circles: https://donatstudios.com/PixelCircleGenerator Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Map: Timberpunk 2 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619180600 Mods: - TImprove - First Person View Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers

In this video: - Tear out majority of the thorns on the map - Adding water dumping ponds across the center, reclaiming a lot of land - Construct a massive circular wall to protect everything - Start construction of a new vault expansion - Add a hidden web of tube way networks across the map for easy access to any point of the wall The tool I used to draw circles: https://donatstudios.com/PixelCircleGenerator Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Map: Timberpunk 2 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619180600 Mods: - TImprove - First Person View Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers

items.title: A City is Reborn - Thornbreakers #14
items.description: After multiple episodes of hiding all my supplies and industry in the surrounding caves, it is finally time to redesign the very heart of the colony: our central district and homes. In this episode: - I tear down and re-build all of the center basin in a walled city - Setup an indicator to show the water level of the vault - Clear out a significant amount of thorns! - Start construction on the end-game wonder - Redo a substantial part of the tube way network With everything built up now, the next big step will be to start venturing farther and farther into the barren wastes and starting to terraform them https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Map: Timberpunk 2 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619180600 Mods: - TImprove - First Person View Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers

items.title: Hiding all my Industry - Thornbreakers #13
items.description: Water supply? Hidden. Pumping station? Locked away. Industry? In plain sight :( In today's episode I'm going to be taking all the industry that my Timberborn colony has collected over this playthrough and hide it away, buried deep under the cliff wall and hidden from any other curious neighboring beaver colonies. At the same time, I'm going to be giver a big boost to our beaver happiness by building all sorts of new amenities buildings in the giant cave complex. With these changes, I'm setting the stage for a big update to the central basin! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Map: Timberpunk 2 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619180600 Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers

items.title: Underground Pumping Stations - Thornbreakers #12
items.description: It's time to start on re-arranging and cleaning up the central basin! I want to have a nice set of canals in the center of the basin, and I've been avoiding it for so long because our pumping arrays have been in the way. In this video I decide to change up the design: keeping in the design of the vault I opt to move all our water pumps into a vast underground complex, allowing the Thornbreakers to hide their precious water from any suspicious Folktail eyes! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Map: Timberpunk 2 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619180600 Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers

items.title: All rivers must lead to the Vault - Thornbreakers #11
items.description: We are entering late game on Timberpunk 2. After securing the colony from the longest droughts, I continue my expansion in to the wastes. In this episode, I start tracking down more and more water sources out the basin and funneling into back to our colony basin. From there, it is all sucked up into "THE VAULT", a big complex hidden in the cliff face and powered by a ton of compact mechanic pumps. In this video: - Treking into the waste to find and turn on ~10 new additional sources of water - Creating an elaborate tunnel network to route that water back to the basin - Automation and mechanical pumps! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062090/Timberborn Map: Timberpunk 2 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619180600 Computer Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 64GB DDR5 Ram GeForce RTX 5090 #timberborn #thornbreakers #strategygames #colonybuilder #strategy #letsplay #letsplay #citymanagement #colonysim #beavers
